title: Replacement of Roof slab in Powerhouse & Inspection Quarter and Improvement works at Kilakkarai Lighthouse station
summary: Open e-tender (percentage rate) for replacing the roof slabs of the powerhouse and inspection quarter and other improvement works at Kilakkarai Lighthouse, Ramanathapuram district, Tamil Nadu.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Deep Bhavan, 5/20 Jaffer Syrang Street, Chennai

sites.name: Kilakkarai Lighthouse station
sites.work: Replacement of roof slab in powerhouse and inspection quarter and improvement works

scope.item: Replacement of roof slab in Powerhouse & Inspection Quarter and improvement works (BOQ not included in notice)

money.notes: Estimated cost includes 18% GST. EMD by DD/FDR of scheduled/nationalized bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai, valid three months (90 days) from technical bid opening. Tender fee and EMD exempted for valid MSME/NSIC certificate.

period.bid_validity: 90 days from date of opening of technical bid

eligibility: Valid registration in appropriate category and class with CPWD, State PWD, Railways, MES, BSNL or other State/Central Government/PSU/autonomous bodies

Similar works completed in last seven years: three works each >= 40%, two >= 50% or one >= 80% of estimated cost; only fully completed works with completion certificate; values updated at 7% simple per annum; certificates from officers below Executive Engineer not considered
Similar works: any type of construction of building/compound wall/retaining wall/RCC work, and repairs and civil maintenance of building
Average annual turnover on construction works at least 40% of estimated cost over last 3 financial years ending 31 March 2025, CA certified
Key technical personnel for supervision and execution

Unconditional tender undertaking (Annexure III), tender acceptance letter (Annexure II), non-blacklisting affidavit, list of relatives serving in MoPSW/DGLL, Make in India self-certification (Annexure VI)
notes: Section I NIT only; BOQ and scope in the full tender document on CPPP. Bid download/submission period 25/02/26 09:00 to 18/03/26 15:00; opening 19/03/26 15:00.
